description: Provider-neutral llm core and the anthropic adapter. Go is canonical. redact_uri: credential masking of provider URIs (RedactURI). parse_uri: scheme://[host:port/]model[?params] parsing; error is the exact message. anthropic_request: the Messages API body an adapter sends for a request (tools present: tool-calling call, else completion), compared as JSON. anthropic_request_error: requests the adapter rejects before sending, exact message. anthropic_headers: auth and routing headers from the key and the ANTHROPIC_* environment. anthropic_stream: text tokens a stream yields from an SSE body, then done or an error. anthropic_accumulate: the message an SSE body folds into (the Go SDK's Message.Accumulate). anthropic_error: how HTTP responses map to error kinds, whether the kind is fallbackable, and how many attempts the default retry policy makes; the last response repeats. Retry waits a server asks for are honored only within (0, 60s]; other values fall back to backoff. key_endpoint: where a resolved key may go (op apply: ApplyAPIKey's URI, or refused; op load: LoadConfig refused or not; op resolve: Resolve with the URI's own key refused or not): a key from llm.yaml or the environment reaches a URI-named endpoint only when loopback or the same origin as the provider's default or configured endpoint, a URI's own key any https host, and no key goes over plain http to a remote host. credential_headers: the credentials the anthropic adapter sends for a base URL; ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID go only to a trusted origin (the default endpoint, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, llm.yaml base_url, LLM_BASE_URL, loopback), and plain http to a remote host is refused. Endpoints parse with each client's own URL parser; an endpoint with userinfo, a backslash, a percent-escape, whitespace or control characters never receives a credential. anthropic_stream error_kind names the typed error a stream ends with (an SSE error event by its type; a body ending without message_stop is truncated). anthropic_error runs with the key conf-key-must-not-leak, which no error text may contain; stream marks a streamed call; redirects are not followed. anthropic_limits: max_body_bytes and max_event_bytes provider params bound what a response may hold. Requests may carry thinking_budget (extended thinking), cache_control on messages and tools, and thinking blocks to replay. anthropic_response: Messages API responses parsed (text, thinking blocks, tool calls, stop reason, usage with cache tokens). usage_cost: usage priced per million tokens by kind. tool_names: tool-name validation and the deterministic sanitizer (README, Tool names): a rule (anthropic, openai, gemini), a mode (sanitize, the default, or strict), the tools' names in order, then the wire names (want) or the first error (reason, name, other); calls map back to want_calls. anthropic_tool_names: the adapter end to end: tool and history tool_use names sent, tool calls returned (call, stream_tools) carrying the original name, errors before any request, and the tool_names provider param (refused for an unknown mode).
